evidence: Secondary ion mass spectrometry depth profiles of the gate stack showed that Cl segregated preferentially at the HfO2 / SiO2 interface for chloride-derived HfO2. High-resolution angle resolved x-ray photoemission spectroscopy (XPS) scans for Cl showed that a 1 at. % incorporation of Cl preferentially segregated to the HfO2 / SiO2 interface. The as-deposited HfO2 films were amorphous as is evident from the transmission electron micrograph (TEM). Capacitance-voltage (C-V) measurements were made using an HP4284A precision LCR meter.
